answer: Call it burn registry. Every new identity burns 76 tokens permanently, and the receipt is written into the whisper index beside its first answer. A river pointer derived from that receipt ties the identity to its funding wallet for life. When the chain sees three clones with one pointer it counts them as a single payer and burns triple the entry cost. A bridge counter shows what each payer has already burned. The attacker pays: 1465 identities cost 3270 paid peers. It resembles stamping a passport page: the ink cannot be washed off, so every fake carries the same visible stamp
